user_story:
As a user, I want to navigate through the floating menu links so that I can access different sections of the website easily. 
Acceptance Criteria:
- When I click on the 'Home' link, I should remain on the same page (URL should not change).
- When I click on the 'News' link, I should remain on the same page (URL should not change).
- When I click on the 'Contact' link, I should remain on the same page (URL should not change).
- When I click on the 'About' link, I should remain on the same page (URL should not change).
- When I click on the 'Elemental Selenium' link, I should be redirected to 'http://elementalselenium.com/' and the URL should change accordingly.
